full_prompt_en: A square ink-and-brush illustration shows a dark swordsman leaning over two swords against an uninterrupted vivid red ground. The background is a flat, saturated crimson field that reaches every edge, with no horizon or architectural detail. The figure occupies the left and central portions of the frame, cropped below the hips and seen in profile toward the right. His upper body bends forward, and his lowered face is largely built from rough black marks with small gray highlights on the nose, cheek, and brow. Long dark hair is gathered into a topknot, while loose strands whip across his face and into the red space. A layered robe wraps the shoulders and arms; broad black brush masses, scratches, and flecks of red describe its folds and worn surface. At the lower right, one hand grips a patterned sword hilt. Another dark hilt crosses just below it, and a bright diagonal blade or scabbard edge cuts from the lower left toward the hands. A thin cord hangs in an arc from the upper hilt, adding a delicate curve to the otherwise forceful diagonals. The ink texture varies from dense near-black silhouette to broken dry strokes and scattered spatters, letting the red base show through the body. Small pale gray touches create momentary volume in the face and sleeves without softening the overall graphic impact. Illumination is expressed as hard selective highlights on dark form rather than a natural light source, with most of the figure held in strong shadow. The overall composition is tense and immediate, using a compressed profile, crossed weapon lines, and stark black-red contrast to suggest contained movement.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形墨笔与刷绘插画呈现一名深色剑士俯身握着两把刀，背后是连续不断的鲜红底色。背景是延伸到各边缘的平涂饱和绯红，没有地平线或建筑细节。人物占据左侧与中央，下半身在臀部以下被裁去，以朝右的侧面入画。他上身前倾，低垂的面孔主要由粗粝黑迹构成，鼻、颊和眉骨处有少量灰色亮点。长深发束成发髻，松散发丝甩过面前并进入红色空间。层叠长袍裹住肩臂；宽阔黑色刷痕、刮擦和透出的红点描述衣褶与磨损表面。右下方，一只手握着带纹样的刀柄。另一道深色刀柄从下方交叉，一条明亮的斜向刀身或刀鞘边缘从左下切向双手。细绳从上方刀柄垂成弧线，为其他强硬斜线加入一道细柔曲线。墨色肌理从浓重近黑剪影变为断续干笔和散落飞点，让红底从身体间透出。少量浅灰触笔给面孔和袖子带来瞬间体积，却不削弱整体图形冲击。照明以深色形体上的坚硬选择性高光表现，而非自然光源，人物大部保持强阴影。整体构图紧张而直接，以压缩的侧影、交叉兵器线和鲜明黑红对比暗示克制的运动。
style_prompt_en: The brush-and-ink style sets near-black forms against one broad field of saturated red. Thick ink masses define the main silhouette, while dry broken strokes, scratches, and spatters let the ground color interrupt the surface. Selective gray highlights reveal volume only at a few exposed planes; most detail is carried by value contrast and stroke direction. Long diagonals cut through a compact dark center, and a few fine curves loosen the otherwise severe geometry. Edges shift between sharp graphic cuts and frayed, splintered brush marks, giving the form both force and motion. The background stays flat and unmodulated so the textured dark shape remains dominant. Light is represented through hard local accents rather than gradual ambient shading. The overall effect is fierce and economical, combining expressive traditional mark making with poster-like color discipline.
style_prompt_zh: 这种刷绘与墨迹风格让近黑形体立于一片宽阔饱和红色前。厚重墨块界定主要剪影，断续干笔、刮痕和飞溅让底色从表面中穿出。选择性的灰色高光只在少数外露平面揭示体积；大部细节由明度对比和笔迹方向承担。长斜线切过紧凑深色中心，少量细曲线松开其余严厉几何。边缘在锋利的图形切口与毛裂碎散的刷痕间切换，赋予形体力量与运动。背景保持平坦且没有渐层，让带肌理的深色形状始终居于主导。光通过坚硬的局部重音表现，而不是渐进的环境塑形。整体效果猛烈而节制，把富表现力的传统落笔与海报般的色彩纪律结合。
theme_en: A dark swordsman leaning over two swords against a vivid red ground
theme_zh: 深色剑士俯身握双刀，背后是鲜红底色
name: Miyamoto Musashi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
